stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: Stop the press if check fails.

stations.title: orders check
stations.text: Finds the problems, then says all went well.

captions: Sefton's script runs orders check before every print run, and should stop on a problem.
Today check finds problems and still says all went well, so the press runs anyway.
You put results and messages on their own streams, add exit codes, then JSON.
Now a problem stops the print run, and the script reads what was wrong.
One tool, read by people and by programs, each in their own way.
